from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
import json,hashlib
import numpy as np,pandas as pd
ROOT=Path.cwd()
OUT=Path('reports/research/510300_industrial_joint_nonlinear_score_v1')
S=Path('reports/research/510300_industrial_last_period_government_full_quantity_anchor_v1')
def now():return datetime.now(ZoneInfo('Asia/Shanghai')).isoformat()
def readj(p):return json.loads(Path(p).read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
def sha(p):return hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
proto=readj(OUT/'protocol.json');plan=proto['fixed_model_plan']
for p in proto['parents']:assert sha(p['path'])==p['sha256'],'已登记输入变化：'+p['path']
save=OUT/'原八背景与九工业状态及两原范围_未读股票标签.parquet'
assert not save.exists(),'已有输出，不重启'
cols=['idx','date','decision_time','valid_features','exit_idx']+plan['features8_reused']
d=pd.read_parquet('reports/research/510300_enterprise_working_capital_source_v1/原八字段与企业周转_未读股票标签_v1_0_1.parquet',columns=cols)
assert np.array_equal(d.index.to_numpy(),d.idx.to_numpy())
rows=readj(S/'全部79原期_完整原载体量义及保守公开钟与同钟多维状态.json')['rows']
assert len(rows)==79 and all(r['current_original_joint_source_qualified'] for r in rows)
fixed=pd.read_csv(S/'全部1711原成员_完整原载体保守公开支持.csv');members=set(fixed.idx.astype(int))
assert len(members)==1711
endidx=max(members)
clockmap={r['economic_period']:pd.Timestamp(r['original_conservative_knowable_at']).tz_convert('UTC') for r in rows}
for f in plan['added_features']:d[f]=np.nan
d['工业原经济期']='UNKNOWN';d['工业本载体保守原可知时间']='UNKNOWN'
d['原收入范围']='UNKNOWN';d['原应收范围']='UNKNOWN'
selected=[]
for i,row in d.iterrows():
 if i>endidx:continue
 t=pd.Timestamp(row['decision_time']).tz_convert('UTC')
 known=[r for r in rows if clockmap[r['economic_period']]<=t]
 if not known:continue
 current=max(known,key=lambda r:r['economic_period'])
 values={**current['original_quantities'],**current['scope_aligned_original_growth']}
 for f in plan['added_features'][:9]:d.at[i,f]=float(values[f])
 d.at[i,'原收入口径_主营收入指示']=float(current['income_scope']=='主营业务收入')
 d.at[i,'原应收口径_票据并入指示']=float(current['receivable_scope']=='应收票据及应收账款')
 d.at[i,'工业原经济期']=current['economic_period']
 d.at[i,'工业本载体保守原可知时间']=current['original_conservative_knowable_at']
 d.at[i,'原收入范围']=current['income_scope'];d.at[i,'原应收范围']=current['receivable_scope']
 if i in members:
  selected.append({'idx':int(i),'date':str(row['date']),'decision_time':str(row['decision_time']),'industrial_period':current['economic_period'],'industrial_available_at':current['original_conservative_knowable_at'],'quantity_definition_clock_supported':True})
features=plan['features8_reused']+plan['added_features']
assert len(features)==19 and np.isfinite(d.loc[sorted(members),features].to_numpy(float)).all()
check={int(r.idx):r.observed_original_economic_period for r in fixed.itertuples(index=False)}
assert len(selected)==1711 and all(check[r['idx']]==r['industrial_period'] for r in selected)
assert all(pd.Timestamp(r['industrial_available_at'])<=pd.Timestamp(r['decision_time']) for r in selected)
assert d.loc[d.idx>endidx,plan['added_features']].isna().all().all()
d.to_parquet(save,index=False)
pd.DataFrame(selected).to_csv(OUT/'全部1711原成员_新工业实际可知字段与时点.csv',index=False,encoding='utf-8-sig')
audit={'at':now(),'status':'PASS_ALL1711_FIXED_SOURCE_COVARIATES_BUILT_BEFORE_RETURN_LABEL_READ','feature_count':19,'old_background':8,'new_industrial_quantities':9,'scope_indicators':2,'fixed_original_members':1711,'parent79_periods_unchanged':True,'original_member_periods_match_E99':True,'unknown_values_not_zero_imputed':True,'source_clock_not_future':True,'2019M07_clock_only_government_reprint':True,'future_after_last_original_member_new_fields_unknown':True,'source_output':save.as_posix(),'source_output_sha256':sha(save),'new_stock_labels':0,'new_model_fits':0,'source_code_edits':0,'new_source_requests':0}
(OUT/'金融标签使用前完整原字段接续必要核对.json').write_text(json.dumps(audit,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2),encoding='utf-8')
print(json.dumps(audit,ensure_ascii=False),flush=True)
